summary: This chunk is dominated by high-attention reference leaders. The main relationship pattern is demand anchors in AI compute, cloud, and power flowing into bottlenecks in advanced packaging, substrates, process control, networking, and grid equipment. The best underfollowed shadows to carry forward are KLA, Ibiden, and Powertech because they sit one or two steps away from obvious AI demand and have clearer chokepoint characteristics than the mega-cap anchors.
